A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ECOCSeg work and include all appendices A–N. Algorithm 1 is visually clipped in v1, but its complete embedded text is recoverable and matches v2, enabling reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original ECOCSeg segmentation experiments, including UDA and SSL comparisons in Tables 1–2, ablations, and additional benchmark and domain results in Appendix G.

after.justification: v2 retains the original ECOCSeg experiments, ablations, calibration analyses, and additional evaluations reported in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The ECOC classifier, codebook strategies, reliable bit mining, hybrid labels, and training losses are unchanged. The complete Algorithm 1 text matches after recovering the portion clipped in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions retain GTAv/SYNTHIA-to-Cityscapes UDA, SSL on Cityscapes, Pascal VOC and COCO, and Appendix G evaluations on WHU-CD change detection and ACDC cardiac segmentation.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding tables, including DACS, DAFormer and MIC in Table 1; ST++, FixMatch and UniMatch in Table 2; and the additional comparisons in Appendix G.

E3.justification: The data partitions, resolutions, backbones, training schedules, optimizers and inference procedures remain unchanged. The SSL settings paragraph moves from page 7 to page 8 without changing its contents.

E4.justification: The loss, codebook, threshold, code-length and quality-estimation ablations are retained, as are the shared-bit, efficiency and calibration analyses. Appendix M contains the same qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the checklist statement that error bars are omitted because of computational expense. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval or significance-test reporting is added or revised.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout. For example, both versions report 68.3 and 70.5 mIoU for DAFormer and DAFormer+ECOCSeg on GTAv-to-Cityscapes in Table 1; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: Theorems 4.1–4.2, the mathematical definitions and equations, and Appendix A's assumptions, lemmas, proofs and derivations are unchanged. Equation relocation and spacing do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims concerning ECOC encoding, bit-level denoising, customized losses, theoretical noise robustness and integration with UDA/SSL frameworks.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability qualifications are unchanged, including stronger benefits for multiclass tasks in Appendix G and the codebook-quality, bit-independence and uniform-noise limitations in Appendix N.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, codebook-generation instructions, hardware and training-cost information, and code-access statements are unchanged. Algorithm 1's full text already exists in v1; its relocation repairs visibility without adding technical content.

R1.justification: The bibliography, Section 2 and Appendix L/Table 16 retain the same cited works and research positioning, including the distinction between label-encoding methods and feature-space approaches.

P1.justification: The front-page arXiv version/date header changes from 7 December 2025 to 10 January 2026, with minor typographic spacing adjustments. The prose, terminology and section sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Algorithm 1 moves from the bottom of page 5, where most steps are clipped in v1, to a complete display on page 6 in v2. Paragraphs, equations and Tables 2–4 also shift with the reflow; figure and table content is retained.

improvement.justification: v2 repairs a concrete readability defect by displaying all 16 lines of Algorithm 1 on page 6. This makes the existing procedure accessible in the rendered paper, providing a limited quality improvement while the scientific content and appendix evidence remain unchanged.
